about_blocks.text: Precision Health’s experience in implementing and administering a DOT compliant drug and alcohol testing program for transportation companies operating in the US saves our client’s time and money by working with our proven methodology and outsourcing the considerable administration functions to us. To get an idea of your company’s obligations for operating in the US, we suggest you read the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration overview of Alcohol and Drug rules at this link. In addition to the transportation sector, we have worked with many organizations in other sectors to develop and administer drug and alcohol testing programs that meet the specific needs of their human resource policies or regulatory bodies.

sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
